messages.subject: Goodness of fit tests
parts:
Hi all,
I want to compare the models for the different species.
    
The problem in sum(log(CPO)) is that it use an absolute measure of the likelihood so if the data is different the comparison is not valid. We need a standardised measure like the R-Squared. 

Any suggestions???

Thank you in advance.
